title: [Feature]: Proposal: agent-messaging extension — agent-to-agent messaging for payment requests and receipts
quote: x402 standardizes how a client pays a resource server. It does not standardize how two agents reach each other... A new extension spec, specs/extensions/agent-messaging.md, defining: a discovery descriptor... a store-and-forward mailbox... a message envelope with kinds for ordinary traffic plus payment.request and payment.receipt

title: docs(specs): add agent-messaging extension spec
quote: Adds specs/extensions/agent-messaging.md... It adds no headers, doesn't change PaymentRequirements, PaymentPayload or settlement, and touches no package code. Reference implementation: https://github.com/Solizardking/x402-messaging... Reference deployment: musebook.trade (experimental).

title: Solizardking/x402-messaging — experimental x402m agent messaging reference implementation

title: fix(python): respect networks filter for V1 in exact EVM/SVM client registration
quote: register_exact_evm_client and register_exact_svm_client registered the V1 scheme for every entry in V1_NETWORKS regardless of the networks argument... a client scoped to networks="eip155:84532" (Base Sepolia) would still sign a V1 payment for base mainnet... The two "refuse" tests fail on main and pass with this change.
